subject: Evidence request: SSO traces, SCIM export and RBAC map for CedarPoint Health SOC2/CAIQ review
messages:
From: Emily Tan <emily.tan@cedarpoint-health.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: security@cedarpoint-health.com
Date: 2028-03-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: CedarPoint - CAIQ / SOC2 access control artifacts request

Hi Laura,

We're in the middle of our SOC2 readiness review and the assessor asked for a short pack covering SSO/SCIM/RBAC evidence for Redwood-managed accounts that access our environment. Specifically they're asking for: 

- SCIM provisioning snapshot (list of users with role attributes + timestamps) covering the last 12 months
- Sample SAML assertion logs for successful logins (tracing NameID, attributes, and timestamps) for a handful of users
- RBAC role mapping (role -> permissions) and any service account classification
- Audit/change log showing any role assignments or privilege escalations in the last 6 months

Can you confirm what we can expect and a target delivery date? Ideally we'd like a ZIP with CSVs and redaction notes. The assessor is on a tight timeline and will accept redacted PII if we provide clear provenance.

Thanks,
Emily
Emily Tan
Security Operations Manager
CedarPoint Health

[Attachment: sample-assessor-ask.pdf (pdf)]

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: Emily Tan <emily.tan@cedarpoint-health.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-03-15T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CedarPoint - CAIQ / SOC2 access control artifacts request

Emily,

Thanks for the clear list — we can provide the items requested. Quick notes and questions so we scope delivery correctly: 

- SCIM snapshot: we can deliver a CSV export with username, email (redacted), role, created_at, last_login. We will include a separate mapping file for role identifiers to friendly names.
- SAML samples: we'll pull assertion samples for 6 distinct users across the last 3 months. We will redact raw emails where necessary and include assertion metadata (NameID, attributes, authnInstant).
- RBAC map: we'll produce an Excel with role -> permission list and flag service accounts.
- Audit/change log: we can provide a filtered change log (role assignment and admin role changes) for the last 6 months with timestamps and actor.

We need to confirm whether the assessor will accept redacted email addresses (they said yes in your note). Also, do you want us to include a short README describing our extraction methods and the query filter used?

Tentative delivery: 2028-03-17 EOD PT if you confirm redaction is acceptable.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of InfoSec, Redwood Inference

On Thu, Mar 15, 2028 at 9:12 AM Emily Tan <emily.tan@cedarpoint-health.com> wrote:
> We're in the middle of our SOC2 readiness review and the assessor asked for a short pack covering SSO/SCIM/RBAC evidence...

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-03-15T10:17:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: CedarPoint evidence pack - extraction tasks

Team — assigning the CedarPoint ask. Goal: produce a ZIP with CSVs/Excel + README + redaction notes by 2028-03-17 EOD PT. Assessor is external; minimal PII. High level tasks: 

1) Marissa: please generate a SCIM snapshot CSV covering 2027-03-01 through 2028-03-01 with these columns: user_id, username (redacted), primary_email (redacted), role_id, role_name, created_at, last_active_at, source (SCIM/API). Also include a separate role_id -> role_name mapping sheet. Note service accounts flagged.

2) Marcus: pull SAML assertion samples for 6 users (mix of admins, service accounts, and normal users). Include NameID pseudonym, attributes, authnInstant, recipient, and assertion_id. Redact emails and include rationale. Provide a small script or filter criteria in the README so the assessor can reproduce.

3) Both: extract change log entries for role/grant changes from 2027-09-01 to 2028-03-01. Include actor, timestamp, object changed, and before/after values.

4) Produce RBAC role mapping XLSX listing roles, attached permissions, and whether role is assignable via SCIM or only via console.

Attachments we will provide: scim_snapshot_2028-03.csv, saml_assertion_samples.txt, rbac_role_mapping.xlsx, access-change-log-2027-2028.zip.

Flag any blockers ASAP — I can escalate to engineering for raw logs if needed.

Laura

---
Quoted for context:
On Thu, Mar 15, 2028 at 10:03 AM laura_bennett@redwood.ai wrote:
> Emily,
> 
> Thanks for the clear list — we can provide the items requested...

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-03-17T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: CedarPoint evidence pack - extraction tasks

Laura / Marcus,

Upload complete — attaching the final artifacts and README to the shared Drive link below. Summary: 

- scim_snapshot_2028-03.csv: contains 1,842 accounts. Emails and usernames redacted to pseudonyms (user_####) per assessor guidance. Role mapping included as first sheet.
- saml_assertion_samples.txt: six assertion blocks with NameID pseudonym, attributes (role_id, email_redacted_flag), authnInstant, assertion_id. We removed raw IP addresses and replaced with region tags.
- rbac_role_mapping.xlsx: 48 roles, each mapped to permission sets. Column F flags service accounts.
- access-change-log-2027-2028.zip: filtered entries for role assignment/admin changes (csv inside).
- README.txt: details on extraction queries, filters applied, and redaction policy.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1aBcDefExample
Doc link (internal): https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-4321

Emily — we'll share the Drive ZIP link and include MD5 checksums if the assessor needs them. Let me know if you need additional assertion samples or a wider time range.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Security Compliance Engineer
Redwood Inference
